title: Question 29
passage:
I thought there were two pairs of gloves on the drying rack.
A. I took mine down when they were dry. B. I wore gloves on the bike ride yesterday. C. The clothes dryer is in the next room.
passageZh:
我以為晾架上有兩雙手套。
A. 我的手套乾了之後，我就把它們從架上拿下來了。 B. 我昨天騎自行車時有戴手套。 C. 烘衣機在隔壁房間。
